MYSTERIOUS_MAP_MOD_DESCRIPTION: Builds an Isaac-style outer floor where every room contains a short branching Spire route, with bomb-discovered secret rooms.
MYSTERIOUS_MAP_ENABLED_DESCRIPTION: Controls whether newly generated acts use MysteriousMap. Disabling it restores vanilla maps for future acts and runs; existing MysteriousMap acts remain playable.
MYSTERIOUS_MAP_ENABLED_ON: MysteriousMap enabled. Newly generated acts will use the exploration map.
MYSTERIOUS_MAP_ENABLED_OFF: MysteriousMap disabled. Newly generated acts will use vanilla maps.
MYSTERIOUS_MAP_MIND_DESCRIPTION: Reveals every ordinary room and its actual type. Undiscovered hidden rooms appear as isolated dotted X markers.
MYSTERIOUS_MAP_MIND_ON: The Mind enabled. Ordinary rooms and hidden-room X markers are now visible.
MYSTERIOUS_MAP_COMPASS_DESCRIPTION: Reveals all special rooms, including bosses, treasures, shops, elites, and rest sites.
MYSTERIOUS_MAP_COMPASS_ON: The Compass enabled. All special rooms are now visible.
MYSTERIOUS_MAP_TREASURE_MAP_DESCRIPTION: Reveals every ordinary room position and its paths. Inaccessible icons remain blank. Hidden rooms are not revealed.
MYSTERIOUS_MAP_TREASURE_MAP_ON: Treasure Map enabled. All room positions are now visible.
MYSTERIOUS_MAP_BLUE_MAP_DESCRIPTION: Shows undiscovered hidden and super-secret rooms as isolated dotted X markers. Their real icons and connections appear only after bombing the matching wall.
MYSTERIOUS_MAP_BLUE_MAP_ON: Blue Map enabled. Hidden-room X markers are now visible.
MYSTERIOUS_MAP_START_WITH_DATAMINER_DESC: For testing: start a new MysteriousMap run with a Dataminer that needs no recharge. In multiplayer, the host's pre-run choice grants one to each player. Solo and multiplayer runs always have a first treasure room.
MYSTERIOUS_MAP_START_WITH_DATAMINER_ON: Enabled. New solo runs start with a Dataminer; in multiplayer the host grants one to each player.
MYSTERIOUS_MAP_START_WITH_DATAMINER_OFF: Starting Dataminer disabled. New runs still have the first treasure room.
MYSTERIOUS_MAP_SHOW_INSTANT_KILL_BUTTON_: In new single-player MysteriousMap combats, show a button that immediately defeats every current enemy. No energy cost. Testing only; disabled by default.
Instant-kill test button enabled for newly entered single-player combats.
MYSTERIOUS_MAP_REVEAL_GLITCH_EFFECTS_DES: Show this run's rolled triggers and outcomes when hovering over the glitched relic. Display only; effects still trigger when hidden. Enabled by default.
MYSTERIOUS_MAP_REVEAL_GLITCH_EFFECTS_ON: Glitched relic combinations are now visible.
MYSTERIOUS_MAP_REVEAL_GLITCH_EFFECTS_OFF: Glitched relic combinations are hidden; their effects still work.
MYSTERIOUS_MAP_REVEAL_OPTIONS_LOCKED: Map-reveal options are controlled by the host during this multiplayer run.
